data_description.max_reminders: Total reminders per dose, including the first. After the last one the dose is marked missed.
data_description.snooze_length: Minutes the Snooze button delays the next reminder.
data_description.early_take_window: How many minutes before the scheduled time a dose may already be confirmed.
data_description.interruption_level: How normal reminders break through Focus modes on iOS.
data_description.require_unlock: The phone must be unlocked before "Taken" is accepted.
data_description.critical_volume: Volume (0.1 to 1.0) of critical alerts, which sound even when the phone is muted.
data_description.history_retention: Days to keep dose history. 0 keeps it forever.

data_description.unit: For example tablet, capsule or ml. Also used for the stock.
data_description.times: Local times of day for each dose.
data_description.instructions: Optional, for example "with food". Shown in the reminder.
data_description.current_stock: Optional. How much you have now, in the unit above. Leave empty to not track stock for this medication.
data_description.low_stock_threshold: Optional. Alert when stock is at or below this amount. Leave empty for no low-stock alerts.
data_description.refill_amount: Optional. Pre-fills the Refill amount on the medication's page and is used by "Refilled" on the low-stock notification. Leave empty for no default.
data_description.critical_mode: Critical alerts sound even when the phone is muted or in a Focus mode.
data_description.active: Paused medications send no reminders. Pausing ends a running dose (recorded as skipped).

error.name_exists: A medication with this name already exists.
error.invalid_dose: The dose amount must be greater than 0.
error.invalid_time: One of the times is not a valid HH:MM time.
error.duplicate_time: Each time may only appear once.

missing_target.title: MedTrack cannot reach {target}
missing_target.description: The phone {target} has no notification service any more, so it gets no medication reminders. This usually happens after the phone was renamed or removed in the Companion App. Open MedTrack, select Configure and choose the phone again. This message disappears after the next reminder reaches it.

rate_budget.title: MedTrack may exceed the iPhone notification limit
rate_budget.description: In the worst case MedTrack could send {budget} notifications per phone per day. Apple allows 500 per phone per day (critical alerts excluded). Lower the max reminders or max snoozes in the MedTrack settings or per medication.

nothing_to_take.message: {medication}: there is no dose to take right now (nothing running and nothing due within the early-take window).

nothing_to_skip.message: {medication}: there is no dose to skip right now (nothing running and nothing due within the early-take window).

nothing_to_snooze.message: {medication}: there is no running dose to snooze.

no_snoozes_left.message: {medication}: no snoozes left for this dose.

stock_not_tracked.message: {medication} does not track stock. Fill in Current stock in the medication's settings first.

no_refill_amount.message: {medication}: enter a Refill amount first, or set a Default refill amount in the medication's settings.

nothing_to_undo.message: {medication}: nothing to undo. Only doses taken or skipped and refills from the last 24 hours can be undone.

not_a_medication.message: Select a MedTrack medication: its device or one of its entities.

single_medication.message: Select exactly one MedTrack medication (its device or one of its entities).

unknown_dose.message: Dose {dose_id} is not known. Only doses from the last 24 hours and the next 48 hours can be used.

dose_not_in_target.message: Dose {dose_id} does not belong to the selected medication.

invalid_period.message: The start must be before the end.

take_dose.name: Take dose
take_dose.description: Confirms the running dose, or the next one within the early-take window, and lowers the stock. Select the medication by its device or one of its entities.

dose_id.name: Dose ID
dose_id.description: Optional. A specific dose, for example from the medtrack_dose_pending event. Leave empty to use the running dose, or the next one within the early-take window.

skip_dose.name: Skip dose
skip_dose.description: Skips the running dose, or the next one within the early-take window. Stock does not change. Select the medication by its device or one of its entities.

dose_id.name: Dose ID
dose_id.description: Optional. A specific dose, for example from the medtrack_dose_pending event. Leave empty to use the running dose, or the next one within the early-take window.

snooze_dose.name: Snooze dose
snooze_dose.description: Delays the next reminder of the running dose. Select the medication by its device or one of its entities.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Optional. Defaults to the snooze length in the MedTrack settings.

refill.name: Refill
refill.description: Adds stock and logs a refill. Select the medication by its device or one of its entities.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Optional. Defaults to the medication's default refill amount.

set_stock.name: Set stock
set_stock.description: Corrects the stock to the amount you counted. Logged as a stock correction. Select the medication by its device or one of its entities.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: The current stock, in the medication's unit.

undo_last.name: Undo last
undo_last.description: Reverts the medication's last taken or skipped dose or refill from the last 24 hours and restores the stock. A reverted dose becomes due again. Select the medication by its device or one of its entities.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns the dose, refill and stock history. Select medications, the MedTrack hub, or nothing for all medications.

start.name: Start
start.description: Optional. Only records from this moment on.

end.name: End
end.description: Optional. Only records up to this moment.
